name: AVYDRIX Play
subtitle: Your Retro Gaming Console
promotional_text: Your games. Your console. Build a personal retro library, customize your controls and console finish, and return to your adventures with protected resume checkpoints.
description:
Your Console. Your Games.

AVYDRIX Play brings your personal retro game collection into a console-inspired experience from CTInteractive. Browse a cover-art library, choose your console finish and keep your favorite games close.

EXPLORE YOUR LIBRARY
Browse the interactive game shelf, find favorites and recently played titles, and add your own cover artwork. Matching covers can be found online when available.

CONTROL EVERYTHING
Open the in-game Command Center for quick save and load, the Save Vault, controls, display options and an exit back to your library.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a console skin, tune touch-button size, opacity and position, remap supported Bluetooth controller buttons, and select sharp pixels, an LCD grid or CRT scanlines.

RETURN TO YOUR ADVENTURE
Manage save slots and use automatic resume with a fallback checkpoint. Keep your own backups; compatibility and state support vary by game and system.

FLEXIBLE SCREENS
Play in portrait or landscape, adjust picture proportions and use supported dual-screen layouts for Nintendo DS games.

Supports NES, Super Nintendo, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance and Nintendo DS game formats. Compatibility varies by title. No account is required.

BRING YOUR OWN GAMES
Import only games you are legally entitled to use. AVYDRIX Play does not sell or provide copyrighted commercial ROMs. Original bundled content and diagnostic cartridges are separate from your imported collection.

AVYDRIX Play is an independent CTInteractive product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo or other console manufacturers.
whats_new: Introducing AVYDRIX Play: a console-inspired game library, in-game Command Center, console skins, customizable controls, display filters, visual save management and protected automatic resume. Includes the official AVYDRIX Play icon and signature startup experience.
review_notes: Existing application and bundle ID retained. No login required. Imported game files stay local. Original Grave Mistakes game and diagnostic carts are bundled; diagnostic carts are accessible through Settings > Advanced > System Tools. No commercial ROM download service. Open-source notices and source link are in Settings > Information > About & open-source licenses. All screenshot and runtime claims must be verified on the submitted build.
status: Prepared from source inspection; feature claims require release QA before upload to App Store Connect. Age rating and privacy questionnaire require completion against Apple forms.
